releases.notes:
## Minecraft (plugins, proxies and mods)

- When the MinecraftAuth API rate limits the server, short limits are now waited out and retried automatically instead of failing ([915dc52](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/commit/915dc5279d638992da7c485222cb1e510e243f92))

## lib/jvm (me.minecraftauth:lib)

- The client honors API rate limits: a 429 with `Retry-After` is waited out and retried for up to `MinecraftAuthConfig.maxRateLimitWaitMillis` (default 10 s); longer limits throw the new `RateLimitedException` (a subclass of `UnavailableException`) with `retryAfterMillis`, and calls fail fast until it has passed ([915dc52](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/commit/915dc5279d638992da7c485222cb1e510e243f92))

## lib/go

- The client honors API rate limits: a 429 with `Retry-After` is waited out and retried for up to `Client.MaxRateLimitWait`; longer limits return an error that `IsRateLimited` reports, with `RetryAfter` giving the wait ([915dc52](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/commit/915dc5279d638992da7c485222cb1e510e243f92))

## lib/js (@minecraftauth/lib)

- The client honors API rate limits: a 429 with `Retry-After` is waited out and retried for up to the new `maxRateLimitWaitMs` option; longer limits throw the new `RateLimitError`, detectable with `isRateLimited` ([915dc52](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/commit/915dc5279d638992da7c485222cb1e510e243f92))

## Caddy module

- Built on lib/go v2.2.0, so the module honors API rate limits too ([6f3ecef](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/commit/6f3ecef6e35387a0f23ee5c3c0edc8c46f3afa50))

**Full changes:** [v2.1.0...v2.2.0](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/compare/v2.1.0...v2.2.0)

releases.notes:
## Minecraft (plugins, proxies and mods)

- Membership checks now use an application's ID and secret. Create an application at https://minecraftauth.me/developers and set `api.application-id` and `api.application-secret` in `MinecraftAuth.yml`. Server tokens were retired: an existing `server-token` keeps working for now, but logs a deprecation warning and will stop working at the end of the API's v1 grace period. ([9b34e76](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/commit/9b34e760a8fb12234388c1715eab7c8d3798687a))
- A warning is logged if only one of `application-id` or `application-secret` is set. ([9b34e76](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/commit/9b34e760a8fb12234388c1715eab7c8d3798687a))

## lib/jvm (me.minecraftauth:lib)

- `Credentials.ServerToken` and `Credentials.ServerTokenBasic` are deprecated, because server tokens were retired. Use `Credentials.Application(id, secret)`, which now also works for membership checks: they answer for the application's owner. ([9b34e76](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/commit/9b34e760a8fb12234388c1715eab7c8d3798687a))

## lib/go

- `ServerToken` is deprecated, because server tokens were retired. Use `ApplicationCredentials{ID, Secret}`, which now also works for membership checks: they answer for the application's owner. ([9b34e76](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/commit/9b34e760a8fb12234388c1715eab7c8d3798687a))

## lib/js (@minecraftauth/lib)

- `serverToken()` and `serverTokenBasic()` are deprecated, because server tokens were retired. Use `application(id, secret)`, which now also works for membership checks: they answer for the application's owner. ([9b34e76](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/commit/9b34e760a8fb12234388c1715eab7c8d3798687a))

## Caddy module

- New `app_secret` option (placeholders supported) for membership rules, used together with `app_id`. `server_token` still works but is deprecated: it logs a warning, and `app_secret` takes precedence when both are set. Error messages and examples now point to `app_secret`. ([9b34e76](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/commit/9b34e760a8fb12234388c1715eab7c8d3798687a))

**Full changes:** [v2.0.1...v2.1.0](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/compare/v2.0.1...v2.1.0)

releases.notes:
First release of the MinecraftAuth integrations for the [MinecraftAuth.me](https://minecraftauth.me) v2 API.

## Minecraft (plugins, proxies and mods)

- Server plugins for Bukkit/Spigot/Paper/Folia and Sponge that only let in players who meet your conditions (Twitch follower, Discord role, Patreon tier, ...).
- Proxy plugins for Velocity and BungeeCord, with optional per-backend-server rules.
- Fabric, Forge and NeoForge server mods for Minecraft 1.16.5 to 26.x.
- Jars are attached below and on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/project/unon2A2m). Setup: [minecraft/README.md](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/blob/v2.0.0/minecraft/README.md).

## Caddy module

- A [Caddy](https://caddyserver.com) module that puts sites and routes behind a MinecraftAuth.me login and only lets chosen players through.
- `xcaddy build --with github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/caddy/v2@v2.0.0`. Setup: [caddy/README.md](https://github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/blob/v2.0.0/caddy/README.md).

## API clients

- JVM (Kotlin/Java): `me.minecraftauth:lib:2.0.0`
- Go: `github.com/MinecraftAuthentication/integrations/lib/go/v2@v2.0.0`
- JavaScript/TypeScript: `@minecraftauth/lib@2.0.0` on npm, dependency-free, for Node.js, Deno, Bun, edge runtimes and browsers
